page.overview:
Who is Blake?

Blake is a magical dog and is best friends with Flynn. He looks very similar to Jake. He appears to be a golden retriever.

Blake is a yellowish tan magic dog with a long nose. He has rounded teeth, and large white eyes with black pupils.
